# Peter Rodrigues Butao

> Peter Rodrigues Butao is a project development specialist, M&E (monitoring & evaluation) consultant, web designer and software developer based in Lilongwe, Malawi. He has 5+ years of experience supporting education, agriculture and community development programmes across Malawi, and builds websites, data dashboards, web apps and developer tools.

## Key facts

- Full name: Peter Rodrigues Butao

- Specialties: Monitoring & Evaluation (M&E), Stakeholder Engagement, Project Development, Web Design, UI/UX Design, Software Development (SvelteKit, Next.js, TypeScript, Python, Node.js, PostgreSQL)
- Metrics: 77 schools reached by a digital education programme, 1,437 teachers trained, 3,400+ students trained in climate & leadership, 2,315 trees planted in community campaigns, 15+ storytelling pieces for donor audiences
- Affiliations: Rotaract Club of Lilongwe (Director of Community Service), Courageous Kids Foundation, Centre for Child Development & Research
- Education: MSc Project Management (Malawi School of Government, in progress); BSc Seed Systems (LUANAR)
